title: Venezuelan Oven Roasted Chicken Kebabs
description: A delicious and spicy Venezuelan-inspired dish that combines the flavors of roasted chicken with the convenience of oven-baked chicken kebabs.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together hot sauce, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken, onion, bell pepper, and cherry tomatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the hot sauce mixture.
Thread the chicken and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
